Exploratory · labels previously opened

RAGTruth original-30 evidence-aware experiment

This experiment keeps the same 30 mixed-v2 features and asks whether RAG evidence conditions help IU-PCR or DUFS-LIU use them better.

Claim boundary. This is not a blinded confirmation. RAGTruth labels had already been opened in the earlier Evidence-Contrast experiment. Feature extraction and fitting remain label-free, but any selected hypothesis needs new data.

Question and experiment map

The highest pooled exploratory test AUROC is 0.8013 for Original-30 noctx / DUFS. After giving QA and Data-to-Text equal weight, the highest task-macro AUROC is 0.7225 for GASP-top50. This difference is important because pooled AUROC can reward task identification rather than within-task grounding. No test result was used to revise a variant.

Terms and metrics

AUROC

The probability that a randomly chosen hallucinated response receives a higher risk score than a non-hallucinated response. 0.5 is random ranking.

AUPRC

Precision-recall area. It emphasizes the positive hallucination class and depends on its frequency.

Paired interval

We resample complete source_id groups 1,000 times. Every method uses the same draws, so differences are paired.

Effective feature count

A gate-concentration measure. It is high when DUFS spreads weight over many columns and low when it concentrates.

Data contract

Development has 624 LOO responses. Test has 1800. All 30 original features are finite in full, no-context and every observed LOO condition. The shared full-fitted transform reproduces original mixed-v2 with maximum error 2.66e-15. No missing feature or chunk was imputed.

Task transfer

QA and Data-to-Text are shown separately. A pooled score can hide a task reversal.

Three scientific questions

Do evidence conditions improve the original 30?

The largest pooled comparison is original30_noctx__dufs_liu versus its full-only reference: +0.0385, interval [+0.0262, +0.0511]. The largest task-macro change is +0.1163 [+0.0795, +0.1544].

Does DUFS add beyond IU-PCR?

The largest pooled DUFS-minus-IU comparison is +0.0028, interval [+0.0017, +0.0042]. The largest task-macro DUFS change is +0.0065 [+0.0047, +0.0085].

What DUFS relies on

The first heatmap averages gates for the same original feature across its full, no-context and LOO summary columns. The second holds the 30-column basis fixed and shows how gates change when DUFS sees only full, no-context or mean-LOO coordinates.

Gate stability and convergence

Three fixed seeds are used. Stable loss is necessary but does not prove that the learned graph predicts grounding.

Feature and task interaction

This is a descriptive, label-open diagnostic. It shows the strongest univariate LOO summary for each original feature in each task. It is not used to select columns.

Confounds

These correlations test whether a score mainly tracks answer length, context length or chunk count. The CSV also contains AUROC after linear residualization.

Audit and reproducibility

  • Score hashes: dev 28728820d73cbf453170956cb78656ce6c9ae0bd05f8590909b9f82f5ddc4e3b; test 27b072439fc2405449e2f378826d24b7d8eb6349646b7c0ae622dc43a1d2f515.
  • Labels are structurally absent from tensor construction and fitting.
  • All methods use the same response order and grouped bootstrap draws.
  • Condition permutations are performed within task and preserve block marginals.
  • Every LIU path checks exact equality to IU-PCR at lambda=0.
  • The exact omitted-chunk text is unavailable in the cache; the experiment uses condition indexes only.

Conclusion

The highest pooled exploratory test AUROC is 0.8013 for Original-30 noctx / DUFS. After giving QA and Data-to-Text equal weight, the highest task-macro AUROC is 0.7225 for GASP-top50. This difference is important because pooled AUROC can reward task identification rather than within-task grounding. No test result was used to revise a variant.

The correct interpretation is exploratory. Freeze one resulting hypothesis and confirm it with a new benchmark or scorer before making a final claim.

Files

METHODS.md defines the mathematics and paper provenance. RUNBOOK.md gives exact commands. CSV files contain every metric, paired difference, gate, weight, confound and feature diagnostic.
